provenance.note: The book prints Kaliber ab .222 Rem. bis 8 mm. The discipline is shot at 25, 100 or 300 m at the choice stated in D.8.10. D.8.18 (Teil D, PDF p. 37) allows optical sights without magnification (DG 3 mod.) and D.8.19 allows only rifles of D.25.1 (DG 3 EPP Rifle), each scored in its own class with the distance, programme and face of this record and no record of its own. D.8.9 and D.8.16 also allow 25 m for the .30 M1 Carbine on a "proportional verkleinerte Scheibe" without a factor or dimensions, so the 25 m variant has no record.
